method.trades: Every row parsed from official SEC Form 3/4/5 XML fields; SEC filing URL emitted per row for manual review.
method.entry_rule: Entry = open of the first regular session strictly after the SEC filing date; gap must be 1-10 calendar days on a weekday.
method.exit_rule: Backtest exit = verified close of the +252 session (delisted names: last observed close, flagged); exit only from sessions that have actually printed.
method.arithmetic: shares=10000/entry_px; mtm=shares*last_px; pnl=mtm-10000; roi=mtm/10000-1; exit_pnl=shares*exit_px-10000; all recomputed independently here.
method.prices: Yahoo Finance / Stooq / Nasdaq daily OHLC; independently re-fetchable via the emitted chart-API URLs. Split-straddling ROIs are withheld (roi_review) until the share basis is confirmed.
